summary: Make owned workspace, process, evidence, quarantine, storage, cleanup, and recovery state explicit and reconciled.
enforcement: Classify every managed resource; register ownership at creation; promote and validate retained outputs; fail closed on protected, evidence, external, unknown, active, recoverable, out-of-root, or link-ambiguous targets; bound cleanup concurrency; terminate only provably owned process trees; retain receipts; and fail overall certification when resource reconciliation fails.
